recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the FHIR-19285 application without reopening separate Encounter diagnosis-use terminology/cardinality work; broader terminology changes should follow the already-audited Encounter/THO issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-19285 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Patient Administration. It requested moving ranked billing diagnoses and procedures out of Encounter and into Account, with Account.diagnosis and Account.procedure structures, sequence/rank fields, coded date fields, and invariants.
initial_application: PR #2668 and commit 194c70c746 added Account.diagnosis and Account.procedure for the issue. Follow-up QA commits refined Encounter comments, Account packageCode text, invariants, and removed an accidentally duplicated Account.procedure.onAdmission. The current source still retained a copy/paste rank definition on Account.diagnosis.dateOfDiagnosis and stale Condition notes that linked to removed Encounter.diagnosis.role and Encounter.diagnosis.rank.
additional_context: FHIR-18829 led to the question of splitting procedure/ranked billing data out of Encounter. FHIR-16148 redesigned Encounter.reason/diagnosis, introduced Encounter.diagnosis.use, removed active Encounter.diagnosis.rank, and directed billing-related diagnosis ranking to Account. Later no-change decisions FHIR-28188 and FHIR-22797 confirm that billing rank/POA concerns should not be reintroduced to Encounter. PA Confluence design notes, PA minutes, and Zulip implementation discussion all support Account as the billing-rank location.
reconciliation: Updated Account.diagnosis.dateOfDiagnosis to describe a coded diagnosis date instead of a rank, synchronized the Account SVG tooltip with that authoritative definition, and updated Condition notes to point to Encounter.diagnosis.use for diagnosis use and Account.diagnosis.sequence for billing-related numeric ranking.
source_changes: source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml: corrected Account.diagnosis.dateOfDiagnosis definition from a ranking copy/paste to coded-diagnosis date guidance.
source/account/account.svg: updated the dateOfDiagnosis tooltip to match the corrected Account StructureDefinition definition.
source/condition/condition-notes.xml: replaced stale Encounter.diagnosis.role/rank guidance with Encounter.diagnosis.use and Account.diagnosis.sequence guidance.

related_jiras.note: Identified the related question of splitting Procedure and ranked billing data out of Encounter, leading to FHIR-19285.
Redesigned Encounter.reason/diagnosis, introduced Encounter.diagnosis.use, removed active Encounter.diagnosis.rank, and pointed billing rank to Account.
Later no-change decision confirms Account and Claim are the billing-specific structures and Encounter should not be changed further for billing content.
Later no-change decision confirms R5/Account changes addressed rank/on-admission concerns without adding those fields back to Encounter.
Already audited on the combined branch; diagnosis-use terminology/cardinality work is a separate Encounter/THO issue family.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting ranked billing diagnoses and procedures to move from Encounter to Account, with Account.diagnosis and Account.procedure structures and coded-date invariants.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed decision and target model: billing rank belongs on Account, not Encounter.

evidence_items.summary: Account, Encounter, and Condition are active approved resources; Account contains diagnosis/procedure billing backbones, while Account.diagnosis.dateOfDiagnosis and Condition narrative had stale wording.
evidence_items.learned: The edited files are in current build scope and the remaining gaps affected implementer-facing definitions and links.

evidence_items.summary: PR #2668/commit 194c70c746 added Account.diagnosis and Account.procedure for FHIR-19285; later QA commits refined the Account/Encounter application; the Condition note was restored before these changes.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was mostly applied, but two stale/copy-paste source locations were missed by the initial application and follow-up QA.

evidence_items.locator: PA design page 51223352 and 2023-02-15 PA minutes page 156537470
evidence_items.summary: The PA design page records dropping Encounter rank and using Account for billing ranking; the 2023-02-15 minutes approve FHIR-19285 by 6-0-0.
evidence_items.learned: Community/work-group evidence supports the Account billing-rank direction and the source-change scope.

evidence_items.summary: February 2023 PA messages say Encounter rank was being removed and Account diagnosis/procedure billing information had been applied for FHIR-19285.
evidence_items.learned: Informal implementation evidence matches the Jira/Confluence/source conclusion and reveals no conflicting direction.

evidence_items.summary: Later Resolved - No Change PA issues confirm billing-specific diagnosis/procedure rank and present-on-admission needs are handled by Account/Claim rather than by further Encounter changes.
evidence_items.learned: These later decisions prevent overbroad reconciliation that would restore rank or billing metadata to Encounter.
